selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: According to the passage, how does the agreement of all prophets help show the truth of this Messenger?
questions.answer: It shows that many prophets point to the same truth, so their shared witness supports that he is a real Messenger.

questions.question: According to the passage, what qualities in prophets point to true prophethood?
questions.answer: Their holy qualities, miracles, and duties point to it.

questions.question: What does that proof say about the Messenger?
questions.answer: It says he is truthful and truly sent by Allah.

questions.question: What did earlier prophets do in their scriptures concerning him?
questions.answer: They announced his coming and gave people good news about him.

questions.question: What evidence from the prophets comes through speech?
questions.answer: Their giving glad news and telling about his coming in revealed books.

questions.question: In “The Fifth,” how many saints are said to give witness?
questions.answer: Thousands of saints are said to give witness.

questions.question: Who else gives united witness after the prophets?
questions.answer: The saints who followed his teaching do.

questions.question: What do the saints see that strengthens their belief in his message?
questions.answer: They see some of the unseen truths he taught.

questions.question: What do they witness about the Messenger?
questions.answer: They witness that he is truthful and truly a Messenger.

questions.question: If someone asks why the saints’ testimony matters, what is a good short answer from the passage?
questions.answer: Because they learned from him, saw truths confirmed, and then agreed that he is true.

questions.question: Why does agreement matter in the passage?
questions.answer: Because when many true people say the same thing, their shared testimony becomes stronger.

questions.question: What kind of proof is the agreement of the prophets called?
questions.answer: It is called a strong and firm proof.

questions.question: How fully were these things found in this Messenger?
questions.answer: They were found in him completely.

questions.question: How is the witness of the prophets different from the witness of the saints in this passage?
questions.answer: The prophets foretold him and confirmed him, while the saints reached spiritual certainty by following him.

questions.question: Which kind of witness from the prophets points especially to his truthfulness?
questions.answer: Their united deeds and miracles point especially to his truthfulness.

questions.question: Why is his mission described as the highest and most complete among prophetic missions?
questions.answer: Because he is presented as the foremost and most complete in the duties of prophethood.

questions.question: How are the saints described in this passage?
questions.answer: They are described as many people who reached truth, excellence, and spiritual witnessing by following him.

questions.question: What do the saints witness about Allah?
questions.answer: They witness Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: Did the saints accept only some of his teachings or all of them?
questions.answer: They affirmed all of them.

questions.question: What did the traveller realize from the witness of the saints?
questions.answer: He realized that their testimony clearly proves the Messenger’s truthfulness.

questions.question: Who is meant by “this being” in the target passage?
questions.answer: It means the Messenger being discussed in the passage.

questions.question: What three things in prophets are said to show true prophethood?
questions.answer: Their noble qualities, their miracles, and their prophetic duties.

questions.question: What do both groups also agree about concerning the Messenger?
questions.answer: They agree that he is truthful and truly sent by Allah.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention both spoken witness and practical witness from the prophets?
questions.answer: To show they supported him in more than one way.
